<cite ref="Shabbat 109b:9">Sabb. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>שָׁגְרָא תנורא וכ׳</he> she heated the oven and swept it &c.—Part. pass. <he>שְׁגִיר</he>; f. <he>שְׁגִירָא</he>.
<cite ref="Yoma 29a:1">Yoma 29ᵃ</cite> <he>תנורא ש׳</he> a hot oven (in which it is easy to kindle a fresh fire), opp. <cite ref="S02080"><he>קְרִירָא</he></cite>.
